Name: Fancy Artifacts Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3]Gives a new fancy look to museum artifacts items. Meant to be paired with Vanilla Tweaks retexture or any other as you like.[/size]

[color=#f9cb9c]I covered most of the artifacts, except Anchor, Ancient Seed, Ornamental Fan, Dinosaur Egg,  Prehistoric Handaxe, Prehistoric Spapula,  Prehistoric Tibia,  Skeletal Hand,  Prehistoric Rib,  Skeletal Tail. I'm not planning to make retextures for these since I'm very much satisfied with how they look in Vanilla Tweaks mod, so I just use it.[/color]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][u][b]Credits:[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3]Most of item sprites are from this [/size][url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/godot-pixel-items]Godot Pixel Items[/url][size=3] pack by HenrySoftware.
